The Autoconf `install-sh` file originates from the X Window System’s X11R5, specifically `mit/util/scripts/install.sh`. It was later released in X11R6 as `xc/config/util/install.sh`.

The older version carries a **1991 copyright by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology**, with an MIT-style permissive license. Later versions identify the copyright as **Copyright (C) 1994 X Consortium**. The search results also state that FSF changes to the file are in the public domain.
